feeds.title: Jessica In The Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi, I am Jessica, and welcome to my website! A vegan recipe food blog with hundreds of simple, delicious, and approachable recipes. My mission is to provide simple and delicious meals from my kitchen to yours.

feeds.title: Sweet Potato Soul by Jenné Claiborne
feeds.description: A vegan food and lifestyle blog, cookbook, and cooking show! Featuring easy, delicious, and healthy vegan recipes.

feeds.title: The Vegan Nigerian
feeds.description: The Vegan Nigerian is a platform dedicated to making Nigerian cuisine and the vegan lifestyle accessible to the mainstream - through online resources, catering, workshops, and bespoke events.

feeds.title: Healthier Steps
feeds.description: Hi, I am Michelle, I am the voice, content creator, and photographer behind Healthier Steps. I share vegan and gluten-free recipes because of past health issues. My goal is to help you make healthier choices and show you how healthy eating is easy and delicious. My recipes are made with natural ingredients, they are all vegan and mostly gluten-free, free of refined sugars.

feeds.title: I Can You Can Vegan
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Desirée. A foodie since birth. A plant-based vegan since 2017. Here you'll find all of my favorite recipes that even your Omni friends and fam will love.

feeds.title: The Minimalist Vegan
feeds.description: We're Michael and Masa! Minimalist Vegan is a resource to bring you delicious vegan recipes using approachable everyday ingredients. We publish recipes, lifestyle articles, cooking videos, and host a podcast to help you live with less stuff and more compassion.

feeds.title: Chocolate for Basil
feeds.description: Jerrelle is an incredible food photographer and healthy recipe developer. She wrote a cookbook called Black Girl Baking operates her own food photography studio and contributes recipes to The NY Times.

feeds.title: Eat With Afia
feeds.description: My name is Afia Amoako and I am the creator and curator of this blog. In this blog, you will find tasty recipes that are easy, cheap, and pay homage to my Ghanaian roots. In addition to food, I share tips about living a healthy lifestyle and share more about my Ghanaian identity as well as some tasty eats from around the African content.
